cases.case_label: Alu insertion-mediated exon deletion in NDUFV2
cases.mechanism_detail: In a patient with the missense c.580G>A on the other allele, genome sequencing found a heterozygous deletion of one NDUFV2 exon whose breakpoint involved an Alu insertion-mediated rearrangement; RNA-seq showed skipping of the deleted exon.
cases.quote: Genome sequencing revealed a novel heterozygous deletion in NDUFV2, which included one exon and resulted in exon skipping.
